rawContent: Just in case Trump's new "law and order" framing is confusing, he is labeling Americans who take to the streets to proclaim that #BlackLivesMatter as a violent threat. He is labeling protest, a constitutionally protected act that's as American as apple pie, as a violent threat.

Another day, another Black man is killed by police. Danie Prude was experiencing a mental health crisis. Police suffocated him with a hood. THIS is Americans are taking to the streets.  #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/RlsPDhMMFQ

"The killing of Breonna Taylor reveals yet again how easy it is for the state to take a Black life and how hard it is to hold the state accountable for its transgression." The system is working the way it was designed. #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/EL7dFip2EP
